name: Mike Pence

lean.basis: Republican congressman (2001–2013), chair of the Republican Study Committee and House Republican Conference, governor of Indiana and Trump's vice president (2017–2021).

source.title: File:Mike Pence official Vice Presidential portrait.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Former Vice President of the United States (2017–2021)
summary: Mike Pence, a former talk-radio host, served six terms in the House, where he chaired the Republican Conference, then as governor of Indiana before becoming Trump's vice president in 2017. His refusal to block certification of the 2020 election on January 6, 2021 led to a lasting break with Trump.

timeline.role: US representative from Indiana; House Republican Conference chair (2009–2011)
